title: Home Assistant Material: full interface polish

Main.dc.html.title: Front door of the app, wide, dark

Lists.dc.html.title: A list page: automations, wide, dark

n-front.text: The polish in one line: every page gets ONE loud thing and everything else goes quiet. Here the loud thing is the greeting. The amber block only appears when something needs the person. Type is Roboto Flex at weight 800, widened, tight. Radii: 48 on the hero, 32 on blocks, 20 on rows. Counts are big numerals, never small grey text.

n-front2.text: Motion on this page. Entry: the hero rises 24 px with a spring, then blocks follow 60 ms apart. The repair numeral counts up from 0. Area tiles lift 4 px and their icon tilts on press. Nothing loops. With reduced motion everything is simply there.

n-settings.text: Settings today is 18 equal rows, so nothing leads. Polish: the search becomes the hero (it is how people really find a setting), the repair banner keeps its amber, the six places people go most are large tiles with their live count as a big numeral, and the rest stay as compact rows under a quiet heading.

n-lists.text: List pages today stack a statistics card, a filter row, a second filter row and a table header before the first item. Polish: the title carries the count as a numeral, statistics become four tiles that are also filters, one filter row, and each item is a tall rounded row with its state as a large switch. The create button is the one loud thing.

n-motion.text: Press Play. Each button plays one of the dramatic moments, used only where something real happened: arriving on a page, a count changing, saving, deleting, an update finishing, an error. Drama scales with the Confirmation drama setting already in the product (Off, Calm, Standard, Dramatic) and is off under reduced motion, where the final state simply appears.

n-deenwah.text: Nothing is removed on a phone. The hero shrinks its type, tiles go two across, the toolbar's extra actions move behind More, and the bottom bar keeps Home, Search, Pages, Settings and Menu. Every target is 48 px or taller.
